column1: # UniProt subcellular-location term -> feature category map.
# vocabulary subcell.txt, UniProt Knowledgebase release 2026_02, which is the
# same release as the pinned sequence data. Swiss-Prot is a section of that
# release, not a separately versioned product.
# Assignment is by ANCESTRY in the CV hierarchy (HI is-a / HP part-of), never by
# substring matching. A term belongs to a category iff it is, or descends from,
# category : one or more of nucleus, cytoplasm, membrane, mitochondrion,
#            secreted - semicolon separated when a term descends from several -
#            or "other" when the term is a real CV location reaching none of
#            them. The features are multi-label, so several columns may be 1.
# Six of the seven features are decided by this table: the five CV-rooted
# categories and `other`. The seventh, subcell_unknown, is NOT here and cannot be
# produced by a term lookup - it is a property of the RECORD, set when a UniProt
# record exists and annotates no subcellular location at all.
# An ABSENT record is a different case again: it yields NA in all seven columns,
# including subcell_unknown. Never 0, and never subcell_unknown = 1.
